description: This file defines the PHP class BuzzFeedPostModel, which implements normalization of a BuzzFeedPost data object for API serialization. It includes OpenAPI annotations describing the schema for different post types (text, photo, video, share) and their properties, and contains methods to convert the data object into an array suitable for API responses.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPostModel
classes.description: A PHP class that wraps a BuzzFeedPost object to provide an array representation conforming to the OpenAPI schema for API responses.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the wrapped BuzzFeedPost object into an associative array matching the defined API schema, including conditional inclusion of video link and photo IDs.
